story: Daft Punk Easter Egg in the BPM Tempo of Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger?
text: Daft Punk are very clever in the way they make their music. Their song "One More Time" is a simple three-part sample from a 70s disco song. This video is a great visualization on how it's composed. Absolutely incredible. [VIDEO]
Wow, what an amazing breakdown video visualization. I see there are a bunch of these, for e.g. Daft Punk [VIDEO] , Britney Spears [LINK] , Fatboy Slim [LINK]
